question: I'm reading https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay — I'm switching my whole house to rechargeable AAs. Which batteries and which 8-bay charger should I get?
query: Deal Electric AA AAA NiMH battery charger 8 bay 16 bay product specifications

replays.text:
**My practical pick:** the [Tenergy Centura 16-AA bundle with the TN162 8-bay charger](https://power.tenergy.com/combo-tn162-8-bay-smart-aa-aaa-nimh-nicd-charger-16-pack-centura-aa-nimh-rechargeable-batteries/). It’s a ready-made set of 16 AA NiMH batteries and an 8-bay smart charger.

The [TN162 charger](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-tn162-8-bay-smart-aa-aaa-nimh-nicd-battery-charger/) handles AA and AAA NiMH/NiCd batteries. If you’d rather buy the charger and batteries separately, the same charger is also sold with [16 Tenergy Premium AAs](https://power.tenergy.com/combo-tn162-8-bay-smart-aa-aaa-nimh-nicd-charger-16-aa-premium-nimh-rechargeable-batteries/).

I can’t make a reliable performance comparison between Centura and Premium from the available product details; both are listed as AA NiMH options. The article you linked is about comparing chargers, but the search result doesn’t show its specific recommendation or test details. ([Dealectric article](https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay))

**My straightforward pick:** the [Tenergy 16-pack of Premium AA NiMH batteries bundled with its TN162 8-bay charger](https://power.tenergy.com/combo-tn162-8-bay-smart-aa-aaa-nimh-nicd-charger-16-aa-premium-nimh-rechargeable-batteries/). It gets you started with one charger and 16 AA cells, and the charger is listed for AA/AAA NiMH batteries. If you already have batteries, the [TN162 charger by itself](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-tn162-8-bay-smart-aa-aaa-nimh-nicd-battery-charger/) is the matching option.

For a whole-house changeover, one 8-bay charger may become a bottleneck: it handles up to eight cells at a time. If you expect to recharge lots of batteries together, consider the [Tenergy 16-bay charger bundle](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-tn438-16-bay-aa-aaa-nimh-nicd-lcd-smart-battery-charger-8pc-premium-aa-8pc-premium-aaa/) instead—or add another 8-bay charger later. The [guide you’re reading](https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay) compares the 8- and 16-bay choices.

I’d start with the 16-cell bundle, then add cells and charging capacity as you see how many your household actually uses. Keep rechargeable cells together in labeled sets, and don’t mix rechargeable and disposable AAs in the same device.

**My pick for a whole-house switch:** the [Tenergy Centura AA 16-pack with the TN162 8-bay charger](https://power.tenergy.com/combo-tn162-8-bay-smart-aa-aaa-nimh-nicd-charger-16-pack-centura-aa-nimh-rechargeable-batteries/). It’s a straightforward starter set: 16 AA cells and a smart charger that can charge up to eight at once. You’ll charge the set in two batches.

If you’d rather buy the charger separately, get the [Tenergy TN162 8-bay charger](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-tn162-8-bay-smart-aa-aaa-nimh-nicd-battery-charger/). Dealectric’s guide compares 8- and 16-bay options; an 8-bay is a reasonable middle ground for household use without taking up as much space as a 16-bay unit. ([Dealectric guide](https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay))
